name: bg-stractium
blurb: Ray-marched shader generates recursive crystalline structures animated in time.
description: ShaderToy shader using ray marching algorithm to render animated procedural 3D-like patterns. Supports hue, saturation, brightness, and speed customization.
use_when: Cutting-edge geometric background for tech or sci-fi hero sections.
avoid_when: Performance-critical pages or browsers lacking WebGL support.
a11y: Decorative shader animation without motion-reduced fallback.
